integrity: Original proof supplied, plus a standalone exact direct-update verifier. Eight small labelled graph cases were exhaustively checked; the infinite-parametric claim is proved algebraically, not inferred from the finite computations. The earlier general edge-reversal and period-two statements are explicitly credited.
limitations: Integer-valued synchronous sign-gradient diffusion on labelled bistars only; counts recurrent primitive two-cycles, not attraction basins or transient-time distributions. Unrestricted counts admit negative heights; separate generating function imposes both-phase nonnegativity. Indexed searches cannot exclude unindexed equivalent theorems.
title: Exact recurrent-orbit and minimum-resource laws for integer diffusion on bistars
